stories.title: McKenna gets benched, scores in latest Leafs’ loss
stories.summary: Gavin McKenna had the puck on his stick, looking to make a play in the offensive zone with the Maple Leafs already in a hole.

stories.title: Newhook, Fowler lead Canadiens over Maple Leafs
stories.summary: Alex Newhook scored twice in the first period and Jacob Fowler made 26 saves as the Montreal Canadiens topped the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-2 on Saturday.

stories.title: Price, Bergeron headline 2026 Hall of Fame class
stories.summary: Carey Price spent a lot of his youth on the road and in the air.

stories.title: Alouettes advance to Grey Cup with East final win
stories.summary: Davis Alexander led his team back to the Grey Cup.

stories.title: Quebec confirms infected cow as outbreak of raccoon rabies continues
stories.summary: The Quebec ministry of agriculture, fisheries and food says the cow died on Oct. 30, the day the first symptoms appeared, and the rabies infection was confirmed on Wednesday.

stories.title: Seven officers fired, a force under scrutiny: Can Montreal police rebuild public trust?
stories.summary: Seven officers have been fired amid a sweeping misconduct scandal. Critics question if firings and transparency are enough for Montreal police to deliver accountability.

stories.title: Call of the Wilde: Cole Caufield scored in overtime yet again as the Montreal Canadiens beat the Utah Mammoth
stories.summary: Nick Suzuki's return was the key as he counted three points to lead the Canadiens to victory over the Utah Mammoth in overtime 5-4.

stories.title: Online gambling more than doubles among young Montreal men, study finds
stories.summary: A new study finds online gambling has more than doubled among young Montreal men, as treatment providers report more young people seeking help.

stories.title: Man dies after his arrest for death of Montreal woman during work video call
stories.summary: A 33-year-old man accused of fatally attacking a 45-year-old woman while she was on a video call in Montreal earlier this year has died.

stories.title: Montreal police investigate suspected arson at kosher bakery for 2nd time this week
stories.summary: Police said the hate crimes unit was assigned to the investigation because of the kosher bakery's ties to the Jewish community.
